Range) |pvp_hidden = {{Attr|Hidden|Yes}} |pvp_lead = {{Attr|Lead|Yes}} (Splash only) |pvp_flying = No |pvp_attributes = Bubble Shield }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''War Machine Sentry''', internally referred to as '''Sentry4''', is the fourth and last sentry that is spawned by the [[Engineer]]. It spawns when the [[Engineer]] is at Level 6. It does not spawn on the path and instead on a ground spot in the [[Engineer]]'s sentry placement range. It takes about 1.75 second to build the '''War Machine Sentry'''. Before the '''War Machine Sentry''' starts firing, it needs to rev-up its miniguns. The rev-up time is 1.5 seconds. It has a rocket launcher, which fires two rockets in a quick burst. The '''War Machine Sentry''' also has a shield. This shield prevents the '''War Machine Sentry''' from being damaged by any enemy's ability. This shield is only active when the [[Engineer]] itself is not stunned. There is a limit of four units per [[Engineer]] when it is at Level 6, limiting the amount of '''War Machine Sentries''' it can spawn. In [[PVP]] mode, this is reduced to three units per [[Engineer]]. ==Appearance== The '''War Machine Sentry''' is a quadpod device constructed out of metal, colored black and white. It is a sentry that uses a mounted minigun to attack enemies, which spins when attacking enemies. It has a red laser and two rocket launchers which fire missiles mounted on top. It also has a red shield, which disappears when the [[Engineer]] that spawned the '''War Machine Sentry''' is stunned. There is also a 5% chance that the '''War Machine Sentry''' will spawn with a cosmetic teddy bear on it. ==Skins== {| class="light-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" ! |[[File:GraveDiggerWarMachineSentry.png|175px]] |[[File:PlushieWarMachineSentry.png|175px]] |[[File:PhantomWarMachineSentry.png|175px]] |[[File:FallenWarMachineSentry.png|175px]] |- !Skin |{{Color|Lunar|Grave Digger}} |{{Color|Other|Plushie}} |{{Color|Phantom|Phantom}} |{{Color|FallenMission|Fallen}} |- !Obtained From |[[Lunar Overture Event#Lunar Overture Season Pass|Lunar Overture Season]] |[[Codes|Code]]Can be obtained by using a code you got for purchasing an [[Engineer Plush]]. |[[Phantom Crate]] |[[Mission Quests]] |- ! |[[File:DarkFrostWarMachineSentry.png|175px]] |[[File:BeachWarMachineSentry.png|175px]] |[[File:GhostWarMachineSentry.png|175px]] |[[File:SpringtimeWarMachineSentry.png|175px]] |- !Skin |{{Color|OperationICE|Dark Frost}} |{{Color|Surf|Beach}} |{{Color|Null|Ghost}} |{{Color|Shamrock|Springtime}} |- !Obtained From |[[Operation I.C.E Event#Operation I.C.E Battle Pass|Operation I.C.E Battle Pass]] |[[Surf & Turf Battle Pass#Battle Pass|Surf & Turf Premium Battle Pass]] |[[Null & Void Event#Null & Void Battle Pass|Null & Void Premium Battle Pass]] |[[Shamrock Crate]] |- ! |[[File:BunnyWarMachineSentry.png|175px]] |[[File:ScubaOpsWarMachineSentry.png|175px]] |- !Skin |{{Color|SpringFrenzy|Bunny}} |{{Color|Scuba|Scuba Ops}} |- !Obtained From |[[Spring Frenzy Battle Pass]] |[[Scuba Ops Crate]] |} ==Strategy== *The '''War Machine Sentry''' can do well against high health enemies that appear later on, such as the [[Fallen Titan]] or [[Summoner Boss]]. *The '''War Machine Sentry''' has [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] detection, making it very useful against high health hidden enemies like the [[Shadow Boss]] and [[Soul Boss]]. *The '''War Machine Sentry''' is not affected by any buff or debuff. *Due to the '''War Machine Sentry's''' shield, it is very effective against enemies that have abilities that damage units, as their shield makes them invulnerable to damage. **Do note that if the [[Engineer]] is stunned, the '''War Machine Sentry''' will lose its shield, making it vulnerable due to its very low health. ***For example, if the [[Molten Warlord]] uses its ''Hammer Slam'' attack, and a '''War Machine Sentry''' is caught in the attack, it will be destroyed instantly. ***The [[Medic]] can be very useful, as its shield can protect the [[Engineer]] from stuns, stopping the '''War Machine Sentry's''' shield from being destroyed. *The '''War Machine Sentry''' can damage [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemies, as both its missiles deal explosion damage. ==Trivia== *The '''War Machine Sentry's''' name might be a reference to the exclusive tower, the [[War Machine]], which is given to anyone who is an moderator or a higher rank based on the game's group. **Additionally, the former and the latter both have miniguns and rocket launchers. *There is a 5% chance that the '''War Machine Sentry''' will spawn with a cosmetic teddy bear on it. The shooting sound will also change. **The teddy bear is the {{RLinkC|12848902|Teddy Bloxpin}} gear from the Roblox catalog. **This is a reference to the now removed [[Sentry]] tower. Before the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]], there was a 30% chance that the [[Sentry]] would have a teddy bear on it when upgraded to Level 5. ***This, at one point, allowed the [[Sentry]] to detect hidden enemies. This is, however, not the case for the '''War Machine Sentry'''. *The '''War Machine Sentry's''' shield is based on ''Team Fortress 2's'' [https://wiki.teamfortress.com/wiki/Wrangler Wrangler shield]. *The '''War Machine Sentry''' was sent out on the path by the devs during the admin abuse part of the [[Halloween 2025 Live Events]]. **This allowed for a rare situation to happen where the '''War Machine Sentry''' can, actually, slide across the path at a speed of 1.5 like a regular unit. ==Update History== {{Scroll|text = *'''17 April 2022''' -
